item.problem_title: Negative controls, proxies and validation data are not integrated into a standard emulation workflow
item.problem_statement: A correctly implemented emulation prevents specific design-induced temporal biases and does not create exchangeability. Active-comparator new-user designs, high-dimensional propensity scores and richer clinical measurement all reduce residual confounding without guaranteeing it. The tools that address what remains, negative control outcomes and exposures, instrumental variables, proximal causal learning and external validation samples, identify under distinct and partly untestable assumptions and sometimes target different estimands. They therefore cannot be mechanically ordered or combined: doing so requires an explicit joint model aligned to one estimand, and no such model is in use, so there is no convention for reporting what each tool contributed or for reconciling them when they disagree. item.problem_title: Transporting an observational estimate compounds sampling assumptions on top of confounding assumptions with no accounting
item.problem_statement: An internally valid estimate need not apply to the health system, population or calendar period where the decision will be made. Transporting an observational contrast requires treatment exchangeability in the source, effect exchangeability across samples conditional on a sufficient measured set, and positivity for both treatment and sampling. A sufficient set is weaker than every effect modifier: modifiers that do not differ across populations or that are irrelevant after conditioning need not be observed. Transport estimators are now being applied to emulations, including post hoc standardization of emulations to their trial populations inside a benchmarking program. What remains is the accounting. item.problem_title: No decomposition separates scientific-target mismatch from protocol compromise, mapping loss and estimation error
item.problem_statement: Three trials are in play in any emulation and only one is usually named: the ideal trial that would answer the decision-maker's question, the target trial the investigator specifies, and the emulation the data support. Specifying the target trial closely around the available data conceals the distance between the first two, and the paper reports one estimate as though the chain were tight. What is missing is not an additive decomposition; that generally does not exist, because the transitions change populations, interventions, outcomes and scales, so the discrepancies do not add. What is missing is a documented lineage: the change from the decision question to the operational causal estimand, the assumptions mapping that estimand to an observed-data functional, and the estimation uncertainty, each recorded separately so a reader can see which step carries the load. item.problem_title: Censoring at death is applied as data cleaning rather than as an identifying assumption
item.problem_statement: Death, treatment discontinuation and competing clinical events change what an outcome contrast means. ICH E9(R1) requires that intercurrent events be handled explicitly, and the causal competing-risks literature distinguishes total effects, controlled direct effects and separable effects, each answering a different question. Applied emulations default to cause-specific hazards or to censoring at the competing event. Censoring does not select among those estimands: it alters the observed-data analysis, and it corresponds to a hypothetical elimination of the competing event only when that intervention is well defined and its identification conditions hold, which is a claim the analysis has to make and defend. item.problem_title: Replication is reported as a binary label rather than as a calibrated comparison of estimands
item.problem_statement: Agreement between an emulation and a trial is informative only when the estimands, populations and measurements are close enough to be comparable, and better design alignment is empirically associated with stronger concordance. The benchmarking programs report this in graded form. What is cited downstream is a binary label, usually derived from interval overlap or direction agreement, and that label discards magnitude and uncertainty and cannot diagnose why two estimates differ: two studies estimating the same quantity imprecisely agree by that criterion, and two estimating different quantities precisely disagree. No reported measure, graded or binary, separates estimand mismatch from random error, because doing so requires aligning the estimands first and then reporting a paired contrast with joint uncertainty, which no benchmarking report currently does as a matter of course.
item.paper: Prospective benchmarking of an observational analysis in the SWEDEHEART registry against the REDUCE-AMI randomized trial.
item.evidence: Publishing the emulation before the trial reports removes the possibility of tuning the analysis to a known answer, and the plan names the comparisons that will be made: risk differences and risk ratios at five years and a harmonized per-protocol contrast rather than the hazard ratio alone. What remains open is the verdict itself. Success and failure are still binary labels with no pre-specified tolerance on the risk difference, and the response to disagreement is an unspecified postmortem rather than a calibrated statement of how far apart the two estimands were.
item.quote: If benchmarking proves unsuccessful, we will conduct a “postmortem” analysis to identify the reasons for the discrepancy.

item.problem_title: Phenotypes enter emulations as error-free binary variables
item.problem_statement: Prescriptions differ from dispensings and dispensings differ from ingestion; diagnostic codes differ from clinical events; death and care outside the system may be incompletely captured. When a treatment, a time-varying confounder, an eligibility criterion or an outcome is a latent clinical state and the emulation analyzes an error-prone thresholded proxy as though it were fixed, differential longitudinal misclassification distorts several things at once. An erroneous weight factor persists in the cumulative weights of every clone that remains at risk. Artificial-censoring membership changes as well, but only where the mismeasured variable enters the strategy, the eligibility rule or the censoring rule. item.paper: Combining high quality data with rigorous methods: emulation of a target trial using electronic health records and a nested case-control design.
item.evidence: This supplies the measurement the entry asks for: outcome phenotype accuracy of 95 to 96 percent sensitivity and 98 percent specificity against medical record review, and the resulting bias quantified by running the same emulation both ways, giving 0.80 with validation and 1.00 without. What it does not close is the general case. Validation covers the outcome only, exposure and confounder phenotypes remain error-free binary variables, the design requires a validation subsample that most emulations do not have, and no correction is applied to the unvalidated estimate; the accuracy figures are reported after the fact rather than propagated into the interval.
